identificationModule.briefTitle: Multicenter Trial of Immunotherapy With House Dust Mite Allergoid
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicentre Randomized Placebo-controlled Double-blind Clinical Trial for Evaluation of Safety and Efficacy of a Specific Immunotherapy With an Aluminium Hydroxide-adsorbed Allergoid Preparation of House Dust Mite (Dermatophagoides Pteronyssinus) in Patients With Rhinitis/Rhinoconjunctivitis and/or Allergic Asthma Bronchiale

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Multicenter Immunotherapy House Dust Mite Allergoid
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: A multicentre randomized placebo-controlled double-blind clinical trial for evaluation of safety and efficacy of a specific immunotherapy with an aluminium hydroxide-adsorbed allergoid preparation of house dust mite (Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus) in patients with rhinitis/rhinoconjunctivitis and/or allergic asthma bronchiale

armGroups.label: P
armGroups.description: subcutaneous treatment with placebo Placebo- physiological saline containing histamine-dihydrochloride 0.1mL, 0.2mL, 0.4mL, 0.6mL of strength A(1000TU/mL) followed by 0.1mL, 0.4mL, 0.6mL by strength B (10000TU/mL) in weekly intervals

armGroups.label: A
armGroups.description: Active treatment with house dust mite extract
interventionNames: Biological: specific immunotherapy with Acaroid, subcutaneously, Up-titration till strength B 0.6 mL (6000 TU)

primaryOutcomes.measure: The primary endpoint is the change of the area under the curve (AUC)of the Symptom-Medication-Score (SMS)after 2 years of double-blind treatment to baseline

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change of the AUC of the SMS after one year to baseline.
Change of Nasal Eosinophil Cationic Protein (ECP) after 2 years to baseline
Immunologic changes IgE, IgG1 and IgG4
Tolerability and safety of treatments during the entire study period

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Positive SPT
* Positive EAST
* Positive specific provocation test

Exclusion Criteria:

* Serious chronic diseases
* other perennial allergies
